r1.disclaimer: Practice for a HireVue-style one-way video interview. Not affiliated with HireVue, Inc.
r1.notice1: Your recordings stay on this computer. Nothing is uploaded.
r1.notice2: You can delete them from the report at any time.
r1.notice3: There is no facial analysis. Only what you say is scored.

r1.connOff: Connection: you appear to be offline
r1.devicesSub: Make sure you can see yourself and the bar moves when you talk.
r1.tip1: Have the light in front of you, not behind.
r1.tip2: Find a spot free from distractions and noise.
r1.tip3: Don't worry about eye contact, just be natural.
r1.qHelp: Use the prep time to think. Recording starts when it ends, or sooner if you choose.
r1.answerHelp: Answer in your own words. Stop when you're done, or the clock will stop for you.
r1.practiceDone: That was practice. Nothing was saved.
r1.noRetakes: No retakes left on this question; your earlier take stands.
r1.doneSub: Saving and scoring your answers on this computer. This takes a minute.

r1.typeAll: Add the words for every answer first.
r1.transcriptSum: Your answer, with filler and hedging highlighted
r1.reportDisclaimer: Practice feedback, not a hiring decision.
r1.deleteConfirm: Delete this interview and its recordings? This can't be undone.
r1.unlockedD: A live interview with the Tavus interviewer, 20 minutes.
r1.hedgeTip: Interviewers hear hedging as uncertainty. State it directly.
r1.weTip: You said 'we' a lot. Name what YOU did.
r1.coachWorking: Building a stronger version from your profile...
r1.coachFailed: Couldn't strengthen this answer right now.
r1.coachNote: Built from your real profile. Use it as a model, then say it in your own words.
